title: TruckScenes mini_val shared-ego coverage across radar, corner LiDAR and roof LiDAR
sensor_configuration: RADAR_LEFT_FRONT, LIDAR_LEFT, LIDAR_TOP_FRONT, analysed separately; no point-cloud fusion or detector inference
annotation_schema: TruckScenes v1.2 oriented global 3D boxes; official 12-class detection mapping for the separate box-count diagnostic
split: All 80 official mini_val samples from two scenes; exact tokens in evidence manifest
conditions: No condition filtering; descriptive two-scene mini subset, no weather-stratified claims

environment.hardware: Local CPU-only execution; no GPU or new model run

measurements.name: analysed samples
measurements.scope: Official mini_val sample tokens, all three channels present

measurements.name: corner lidar points at >=150 m

notes: The controlled modality vocabulary uses fusion for multi-modality characterisation; no sensor streams or detector predictions are fused here. These are separate channel distributions in a common spatial region, not a sensor accuracy ranking. Rigid ego alignment leaves residual timing, per-point scan motion, object motion, vertical field of view and occlusion differences. Agent-run analysis, not a human acceptance signoff. Original historical ten-sample counts are unchanged. Camera reevaluation is recorded separately in the experiment report and reproduces the existing scores.
